question: Which qualities of the goddess are honored in this concluding salutation?
premises: The goddess is called maker of water and milk
inference: The salutation honors the wide-eyed goddess who effects water and milk
uncertainties: Symbolic sense of nīra+kṣīra+vidhāyinīm may imply discernment or nourishment
plain_english: I salute the wide-eyed goddess who brings forth water and milk.
